context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin pages use TAB navigation inside /admin (NOT separate URLs). To reach Analytics/Finance/Orders/Disputes/Featured/etc, login to /admin then click [data-testid=tab-{name}] (analytics, finance, orders, dealers, customers, disputes, messages, activity, content, procurement, oem, agreements, pending, approved, featured). Hitting /admin/analytics directly returns 404. Headers in admin tables use CSS text-transform: uppercase so playwright inner_text() returns 'REFERRAL FEE' even though source code has 'Referral fee' — use case-insensitive string matching. Inline-edit interactive flow and Add-Toner dialog opening were NOT runtime-verified because creating an approved supplier requires register→admin-approve cycle which would pollute the production-ish DB; relies on code review of InlineEditCell.jsx + SupplierDashboard.jsx + PrinterListings/PaperListings/ConsumableListings/ScannerListings. If main agent wants live UI verification, suggest seeding a disposable supplier via /api/auth/register + admin POST /api/admin/dealers/{id}/approve then cleanup at end.
